items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: You only took lessons from Charlie and you? That's the only one? Yeah, the only man took lessons from Charlie and me.

ctx.x: Did you take lessons from him, too?

No, no, no. Didn't get a chance to take. He died, man. Yeah. Yeah. You only took lessons from Charlie and you? That's the only one? Yeah, the only man took lessons from Charlie and me. And, uh, and a brother called Adolf Alexander Tetz. Oh, yeah. Called him Tetz. They taught you clarinet. You didn't take lessons on saxophone?
No. Oh, I knew that. One time I picked that dumb piece up, I knew it.
